comments.author: goutham-valugula
comments.text: Confirmed in `packages/workflow/src/utils.ts`: the object branch records `source → clone` in the `WeakMap` before descending, but the array branch does not. Recording the array clone before the loop should handle both shared arrays and self-references. The two reproductions in the report would make focused regressions for those cases.
